description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different models across three categories. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis and include an unlabeled category, CORG, and AdaCAD. The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and ranges from 48 to 62, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 2. Each category has two bars, colored grey and blue, representing "Standard" and "Ours" models, respectively, as indicated by the legend. The grey bars have approximate values of 48, 51, and 53 for the unlabeled category, CORG, and AdaCAD, respectively. The blue bars have approximate values of 59, 59, and 60.5 for the same categories. The bars are grouped by category, with the grey and blue bars appearing side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
